scope: Fresh validation runs using submitted objectives and training budgets; AI choices may differ.

pathmnist.objective: Generate labeled PathMNIST images and determine whether adding synthetic images improves classification relative to real-only training and class-matched real resampling. Select appropriate compatible generative models and hyperparameters from the available catalog without a prespecified model. Evaluate output validity, model fit, overall and per-class image quality, diversity, training overlap, and downstream augmentation utility. Use measured validation evidence for a controlled revision or stopping. Report limitations and do not infer clinical validity from appearance or classifier performance.

pbmc.objective: Generate continuous log-dequantized gene-expression profiles on a small selected-gene panel from PBMC3K for exploratory statistical analysis. Select compatible generative models and hyperparameters without a prespecified model. Evaluate output validity, model fit, marginal distributions, correlations, diversity and training overlap. Use recorded diagnostics and measured validation evidence for a controlled revision or stopping. Integer count generation is not required. Do not infer biological or downstream usefulness from statistical similarity alone.
